notes: The extraction is thorough and generally accurate, with good coverage of pricing, acreage and licensing claims and appropriate hypothetical flags on host calculations. The main problems are treating the $132k as profit when Mike only said 'made', a quote that put Chris's six-figure estimate under Mike's name, a few misattributions and misspellings, and a missed booklet/paid-ads product. Mike's equipment-sales interest deserved more weight in the promotional-conflict field. UK applicability for drone crop spraying was overstated given the UK's restrictions on aerial pesticide application.
